articles.excerpt: World models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn from pixels to predict the outcome of actions in a latent space. To reach a goal, a planner samples many candidate action sequences, uses the model to predict where each one leads, and executes the best one. However, standard planners draw their candidates from a Gaussian, while the model has only seen the structured, state-dependent actions of its training data. Its predictions for such candidates are unreliable, and planning fails more often as goals move farther…
articles.summary: Modelos de mundo baseados em arquiteturas preditivas de embedding conjunto aprendem a prever resultados de acoes a partir de pixels. O trabalho aborda falhas de planejamento causadas por predicoes nao confiaveis em acoes estruturadas.
